build_radial_function: build a RadialFunction module from a list of channel sizes for use in EquiFormer v2
create_radial_function_network: create a RadialFunction with channels [64, 128, 64] to construct a linear-LayerNorm-SiLU network
test_radial_function_forward: test the RadialFunction forward pass by passing a torch tensor through the module
review_radial_function_init: review the RadialFunction __init__ to understand how Linear, LayerNorm, and SiLU layers are stacked
refactor_radial_function_channels: refactor the RadialFunction to accept a different channels_list for varying network depth and width
